note: Closed catalogs referenced by profiles (UNB-ING-PRF-001). Each entry is a reviewed F# function; adding one is a control-relevant change under CNV-PLT-010. Business rules of target commands are not catalog entries: previews call the handlers' validate mode (UNB-ING-BND-002).

validation_rules.fund.exists-in-tenant: Fund reference resolves in the artifact's tenant
validation_rules.account.registered-to-tenant: Bank or custody account registered to the tenant
validation_rules.statement.opening-equals-prior-closing: Opening balance equals the prior completed statement's closing balance
validation_rules.statement.business-date-expected: Business date and sequence match an open expectation
validation_rules.dataset.subsection-codes-known: IRS subsection codes are in the known set
validation_rules.migration.fund-mapped: Legacy fund id exists in the migration crosswalk
validation_rules.migration.units-times-nav-equals-value: units x NAV equals market value within one cent
validation_rules.migration.as-of-equals-cutover: As-of date equals the wave's cutover date
validation_rules.fund.accepts-payroll-from-employer: Fund participates in the employer's payroll program
validation_rules.employee.enrolled-to-fund: Employee reference is enrolled to that fund in the enrollment registry

corroborations.appraisal.valuation-date-within-60-days-: Deterministic date window (consistency with the gift record)
corroborations.appraisal.value-consistent-with-8283-sec: Consistency check against the donor's own Form 8283 (not independent corroboration)
corroborations.death-certificate.decedent-matches-donor: Name and date of birth match the donor record
corroborations.ein.matches-irs-bmf: EIN, legal name and status agree with the active IRS BMF snapshot
corroborations.routing.checksum-and-account-validation: ABA checksum plus account-validation or call-back result

migration.post-opening-balances@1.note: one atomic batch command (UNB-ING-FIN-011), also available to the migration console
